faq.q: What are Weazel News in GTA 6?
faq.a: Weazel News are in-game media titles listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of them. Rockstar has not named them in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Are Weazel News confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Weazel News as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names them.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Weazel News?
faq.a: The wiki gives 2 details. Type: tv show. Listed at: Weazel News Building, Little Seoul, Los Santos. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Weazel News information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Weazel News, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Weazel News?
faq.a: Most of it. Weazel News rest on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Whether it can be watched or read in game and how long it runs are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Weazel News be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of in-game media title entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
